identified_issues: Erroneous audit flag (FLAG_SEQUENCE_DISCREPANCY) raised due to misinterpretation of standard GRID-OPS-STD-2026 Section 7.3
Automated audit script incorrectly assumed central dispatch pre-registration was required prior to autonomous physical actuation
evidence: GRID-OPS-STD-2026 Section 7.3.1 explicitly mandates rapid reserve injection within 100 ms and prohibits waiting for centralized dispatch acknowledgement when df/dt crosses -0.15 Hz/s
Local df/dt crossed threshold at 15:00:00.040Z (-0.22 Hz/s) and breaker fired at 15:00:00.045Z, achieving actuation in 5 ms (well within the 100 ms mandate)
Section 7.3.2 allows a 500 ms window following actuation for ledger notification; transmission was completed in 170 ms (15:00:00.215Z)

Ledger integrity requirements under Section 7.3.3 were fully satisfied: distinct actuation and reception timestamps were preserved, entry was strictly append-only, and zero update or delete operations occurred
recommended_action: Dismiss the false positive FLAG_SEQUENCE_DISCREPANCY and certify Event REC-994102 as compliant (PASS). Update the automated compliance audit rule to recognize that autonomous battery reserve actuations under Section 7.3 are post-notified within 500 ms rather than pre-authorized.
